_status: 2026-11-14 (rev 2, from the operator's photo of the real platform). Geometry of the white chassis + black moulded lid the arm stands in, in the forward-kinematics base frame. Single source for the Blender scene (dev/scripts/blender_arm_sim.py), dev/scripts/blender_platform_check.py and, since 2026-11-14, the control keep-out (src/spatial/workspace.py takes the worse of this lid and the r 8 cm cylinder when arm_limits.json keep_out.platform_shape = rounded_square); tests/test_platform_model.py keeps the shared numbers equal. See docs/current/28a-三维模型与Blender仿真.md section 6.
_frame: origin base_link (URDF), z up, +y = arm forward at J1 = 90, x to the arm's right; metres
shape_note: photo 2026-11-14: a square lid with large rounded vertical corners whose top edge rolls down onto the white chassis walls; the turntable sits in a round flange held by 4 screws near the front of the lid
top_z_source: arm_limits.json keep_out.platform_min_z_m (9 cm chassis over the table at -1.42 cm)

outline.front_source: arm_limits.json keep_out.platform_radius_m (operator: 8 cm from the turntable centre to the platform edge; the map laid against it registers at y 7.5-7.7 cm)
outline.width_back_source: photo estimate (2026-11-14), J1 axis assumed on the lid's centre line; not measured
outline.corner_source: fitted (see evidence); the photo shows a large corner radius

lid.source: fitted (see evidence); the photo shows the black lid's top edge rolling down to the white wall

evidence: 2026-11-14 mesh check (dev/scripts/blender_platform_check.py): link3-link5 STL meshes placed by FK at 1080 contact-free hardware readbacks and the 5 recorded platform contacts. With front 8 cm and half-width 11 cm the data need corner_radius >= 5.5 cm and edge_radius 1.5-2 cm: the binding pose is the near view [49,105,5,0] (32 runs, no contact), whose wrist passes (8.0, 6.6, 7.2) cm, i.e. over the front-right corner below the lid top. With these values the deepest safe pose is +0.13 cm and the shallowest contact +0.14 cm. A sharp-edged square (no corner/edge rounding) is refuted by 0.8 cm. Half-widths 10-13 cm all fit with corner radii 4-8 cm, so the width itself is not pinned down by the data.

hole.source: photo proportions against the r 4.0 cm servo-1 housing (base_link.STL); flange inner radius must clear that housing (r 4.0 cm flange at z 7.0 cm)
